arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} drops knives from enemies hit. Picking them up grants you {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} Energy and increases your {c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} damage by {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} times.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
